entries.english:
He takes Simon, master of theology and of the Order of Preachers, under his and the Empire's protection. Witnesses: Arnest, Archbishop of Prague; the bishops Johann von Leitomischl, chancellor of the court, and Theodorich von Minden; the dukes Bolko von Schweidnitz, Johann von Troppau, Bolko von Falkenberg, and Przemisl von Teschen; the burgraves Burchard, steward of the court, Johann and Burchard von Magdeburg; the nobles Busco von Wilhartitz and Hasco von Swirzietitz, masters of the chamber; Hans von Rosenberg, Heinrich von Neuhaus, and Peter von Janowitz. Regesta Boica 8, 419.

Witnesses: Arnest, Archbishop of Prague; the bishops Johann von Leitomischl, chancellor of the court, and Theodorich von Minden; the dukes Bolko von Schweidnitz, Johann von Troppau, Bolko von Falkenberg, and Przemisl von Teschen; the burgraves Burchard, steward of the court, Johann and Burchard von Magdeburg; the nobles Busco von Wilhartitz and Hasco von Swirzietitz, masters of the chamber; Hans von Rosenberg, Heinrich von Neuhaus, and Peter von Janowitz.
